college_identity.identity_notes: One of the newer NITs, established in 2010 during India's 11th Five-Year Plan as one of ten new NITs (unlike most other NITs which trace to older Regional Engineering Colleges). Initially operated under the academic mentorship of NIT Warangal in 2010-11, then moved to a temporary campus in Dwarka (2012), then to a transit campus at IAMR, Narela. Per one source, fully transitioned to its permanent campus (~51 acres, GT Karnal Road/NH-44, Narela) in early 2022, though other sources suggest campus construction was still in phases as of more recent reviews found in this session — this apparent discrepancy in campus-completion status across sources is preserved rather than resolved. Explicitly verified DISTINCT from IIT Delhi, Delhi Technological University (DTU), Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI), IIIT Delhi, and NIELIT — all separate institutions confirmed on the same Careers360 Delhi-city listing pages.
